editorial:
Imagine waking up to find out your online romance was actually a trap. You are following a college student who gets cat-fished into a sexual encounter, only to realize he is being blackmailed. The vibe here is very tense and stressful, making you feel the panic as he tries to escape a stranger who has a recording of him. It is not about a giant snake, despite the name, but rather a predatory person who hunts their victims through technology. You will find yourself rooting for the main character as he tries to figure out who is actually pulling the strings from the shadows.

The acting feels real, which makes the scary moments hit harder. While the story moves a bit slow in the middle, the ending really picks up the pace with some shocking twists. If you like psychological games, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, I suggest streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video so you can see all the small details in the background. Or, if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out the blackmailer was much closer to the student than he ever imagined. The stranger reveals their true identity in a final confrontation that turns violent. After a desperate struggle to delete the recording and stop the blackmail, the student manages to survive, but he is left scarred by the experience. The movie wraps up by showing that online predators are everywhere and you can never truly trust a screen.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about internet traps and psychological games.
